## Testing
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes (coverage floor holds)
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes
- [ ] Anything that changes how money, time or overtime is computed has a test with an exact expected value
- [ ] No new network calls, and the CSP in `index.html` is unchanged (or the change is explained in `docs/threat-model.md`)
- [ ] User-visible changes are in `CHANGELOG.md`
